CustomField.label: Channel Preference Field API Name
CustomField.description: API name of the field this org uses to record a Contact's preferred communication channel (e.g. a custom Preferred_Contact_Method__c picklist). There is no Salesforce-standard field for this, so it has to be told to the scorecard, not guessed. Leave blank and the Channel Preference Coverage metric reports "not configured" instead of a fabricated number.
